name: Mundo dos Diamantes
rendering: Draw ground and terrain effects first; then characters, enemies, bombs and foreground entities.
performance: Load the atlas once, build per-phase cached tile canvases once, and reuse static map cache. Do not alter gameplay, collision, bomb, enemy or damage rules.
